profile.summary:
Hello and welcome to my profile يامرحبا! About me, I'm a software engineer passionate about architecting scalable, high-impact solutions, I combine 5+ years of technical expertise with a relentless focus on performance, user experience, and clean architecture. My work spans web/mobile development (Flutter, Laravel, Next.js) and Web3 (SUI Network, Smart Contracts), with a proven track record of:

- Leading teams internationally to enhance the work flow while boosting productivity by 75%.

- Optimizing systems—cutting server load, refactoring slow components and APIs and optimizing the app security.

- Building cross-platform apps (50+ screens) and full-stack web apps with applying the best practices and choosing the (current) most efficient solutions.

I thrive in Agile environments, bridging stakeholder vision with technical execution—whether refining APIs, mentoring developers, or exploring blockchain’s potential.

My goal: Let the machine automates the tasks.

Let’s connect!
📩 Contact: alirajab.dev@gmail.com

For more about my work and to connect, visit my Linktree.

experience.description:
• Deployed gas-optimized Move contracts, distributing 1,000+ tokens and 50+ NFTs to users, directly driving a 70% increase in 45-day user retention.

• Spearheaded development of a DeFi dApp for real-time analytics, swaps, and Move-based rewards, serving 2,000+ holders with 95% uptime.

• Integrated 5+ SUI-compatible wallets for seamless user onboarding, achieving 90% successful connection rates.

• Mentored a cross-functional team of 9 engineers in delivering features for a delivery system, driving a 75% productivity increase and 50% user base growth.

• Orchestrated efficient project management using ClickUp and streamlined Git repository management for multiple codebases, improving team collaboration and reducing feature delivery time by 80%.

• Translated stakeholder requirements into technical specs, prioritizing high-impact features that slashed customer support calls by 90% (merchants, clients, delivery personnel).

• Optimized system architecture by refactoring over 10 critical APIs, resulting in an 80% decrease in server load.

- Tech: ClickUp, Flutter, Laravel, Linux, Github, JMeter, GetX, Google Maps, Firebase.

• Architected and developed a cross-platform mobile app (Flutter) from the ground up, featuring 30+ screens with complex navigation and responsive UI/UX.

• Boosted data accessibility by 80% and reduced server latency by 50% through backend optimizations (AWS) and cloud infrastructure tuning.

• Processed 10,000+ rows of flight/airline data, improving app response times by 90% via efficient data modeling.

• Increased app user base by 35% by integrating social sign-in (Google, Apple, Facebook).

• Tech: Flutter, BloC, Clean Architecture, AWS, JavaScript, XCode, HIVE
